'''Tino''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Rebel elite commando/Legends|Rebel Elite Commando]]. He accompanied [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Kiva]] on a mission to stop [[Project Starscream]].

==Biography==
Tino trained with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] soldiers and became [[Rebel elite commando/Legends|Rebel Elite Commando]]. On a mission to [[Kiva]], he was in charge of baby-sitting [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]], [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], and the baby, [[Eppon]]. He died when he was watching the small baby Eppon with his partner [[Bergan]]. When his superior [[Meex]] tried to find them, their bodies were gone.<ref name="Galaxy of Fear:Army of Terror">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Army of Terror]]''</ref>
